verdict.rationale: Manufact exposes a public 'mcp-catalog' with browsable checklist/readiness scores and a scan tool for any MCP URL (manufact-docs-33), which touches registry-discovery, but there is no evidence it surfaces per-server tool lists, input schemas, transport type, or hosting attributes for listed servers prior to connecting — the Inspector/testing features described (manufact-docs-15, 11, 29) are for a server you already own/deploy, not for browsing third-party listings. Missing for 10: catalog UI showing tool/schema details, transport info, hosting metadata for listed servers, and any independent confirmation of the catalog's discovery depth.
